这也就是说，我们的舰船有可能在数日之内就可以由星系的一端到达另一端，这取决于另外的虫洞的位置。不幸的是这个虫洞和大部分虫洞一样，长时间处于不稳定状态。即使有舰船敢接近，也会瞬间被撕成碎片。
texts.en:
We have detected what appears to be a naturally occurring subspace phenomenon on the edge of the [wormhole_system.GetName] system! A rift in the very fabric of space-time has formed here, creating a "wormhole" that, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] speculate, may provide a conduit through subspace to another wormhole located somewhere else in our galaxy.

Depending on where the second wormhole is located, this could potentially allow ships to travel from one end of the galaxy to the other in a matter of days. Unfortunately, this wormhole, like the vast majority of its kind, is inherently unstable. Any vessels foolish enough to pass through it would be ripped apart in seconds.

label.en: If it could somehow be stabilized...

summary.text:
# 天然虫洞 / Natural Wormhole

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/apocalypse_events.txt:103-143`
- DLC：Apocalypse
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

飞船首次进入有天然虫洞的星系（排除虚境隧道枢纽/节点、无形系统、晶体球系统），且本国尚未遇到虫洞（encountered_first_wormhole）时触发 apoc.5。

A ship first entering a system with a natural wormhole (excluding Shroud tunnel nexus/node, formless and crystal-sphere systems), when the empire has not met a wormhole (encountered_first_wormhole), triggers apoc.5.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单窗口通知，设下 encountered_first_wormhole 并让本国“看过”虫洞类型；唯一选项“如果我们能将其稳定的话……”。

A single notification that sets encountered_first_wormhole and marks the wormhole bypass type as seen; its only option is "If only we could stabilise it...".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无分支。

No branches.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.
